post_content:
Small daily things can drastically reduce your stress Talk stress and most
people think of it as some complicated ailment that needs interventions
nothing short of serious ones like daily dedicated meditation or yoga sessions
and counseling with psychiatrists. Most of us balk at these ideas making
stress management appear like an impossibility. Without denying the importance
of these interventions, there are some simple things we all can do in life
that can bring down stress drastically. 1\. Talk (and even gossip) - Opening
up about out feelings and emotions to someone trusted is a proven remedy for
stress reduction. 2\. Breaks - tea, coffee, lunch, snacks and even a REST-ROOM
break - go a long way in reducing stress assuming work isnt on the mind during
these breaks. 3\. Walking upto someone's desk - The simple act of walking upto
someone else's desk for a 2 minute chat breaks the thought pattern and reduces
stress. 4\. Family call - A quick checkin call with your loves ones shifts the
frame of mind. Mysteriously, a wrong number is also not bad. Why do these
work? Because stress is something that builds over time. It isnt the QUANTUM
of stress but How LONG the stress is held that is more important. The above
acts break the longevity - and the accompanying stress.

post_content:
How to learn machine learning in 2020? Same way you would have learnt in 2019,
2018 or even in 2010 or even before Most algorithms that are used today have
been there for decades. Even Backpropogation was out there in 1970 but fell
out of favor in early 2000's due to lack of compute capability in deep
networks. It came back to life with availability of hardware accelerators like
GPU's, distributed computing and cheap compute So when we say this space is
constantly evolving it is not the techniques but application of it in real
world problem Regression techniques have been used for many years now in
enterprise and deep learning is no longer new as well Research space comes up
with new techniques but for it to get large scale enterprise adoption it takes
time. Do not get distracted and focus on what is used at scale first
